description: This PHP source file defines a controller class 'Register' for handling email notifications related to user registration in an OpenCart e-commerce system. It includes methods for sending registration confirmation and alert emails, loading required models and language resources, and dynamically constructing email content.

classes.name: Register
classes.description: Controller class handling email notifications for user registration events in OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles sending a registration confirmation email to the new user. Loads language and configuration resources, prepares email data, and schedules an email task.

methods.name: alert
methods.description: Sends alert emails to administrators about new user registration details. Loads necessary data, validates email addresses, and schedules alert email tasks.
